title: An app you can understand, edit and keep.
description: Start with a working example, learn the pieces as you need them, and choose where your app runs.

cards.label: What is SoftN?
cards.description: An introduction to the editable app format, the tools around it, and the choices you keep after building an app.

cards.label: Build your first SoftN app
cards.description: Make a small change to Fieldnotes, then explore a counter that connects interface, state and an event handler.

cards.label: SoftN Builder
cards.description: Design the interface, write logic in JavaScript or Python, model data and preview a portable app in one editable workspace.

cards.label: App logic in JavaScript or Python
cards.description: Write an app’s behaviour in JavaScript or Python: state, handlers, host capabilities, and machine learning with torch in Python.

cards.label: The .softn app format
cards.description: What a bundle contains, how its manifest configures logic and packages, and how to think about source, seeds and permissions.

cards.label: Hosting and deploying SoftN apps
cards.description: Choose between opening a bundle, publishing an app, hosting one website or connecting a private backend.
